data.content_ref: inline:The proposed 'shared mechanism' relation is not substantively established — it is hypothetical. The target states the token economy 'would explain 0e26d6be54fd's behavior if it also exhibits budget-sensitive emission,' which is a conditional speculation, not a demonstrated connection. The covering principle (token-budget pressure shaping quality through a cost-epistemology tradeoff) is shown to apply to SRC_001 but its application to 0e26d6be54fd is never asserted; it is left as an unverified 'if.' A substantive relation must show the mechanism genuinely covers both endpoints, not merely that it could cover one if a condition were met. The target thus proposes a possible relation rather than a substantive one.
